test_interrupt_next_acting: test the InterruptNextActing component to verify timer vs event priority ordering
test_timer_vs_event_priority: test that timers fire before events when timer timestamp is earlier than event timestamp
test_skip_unmatched_events: test that the component skips events whose tags do not match any entity's interrupt mask
test_multiple_entities_polling: test that only entities with matching masks are polled while others receive pending events
test_tick_increment_behavior: test that the scheduler tick counter increments on each successful poll and skipped event
